statement: Reduction for k=25: any counterexample (25 pairwise disjoint classes, all pairwise gcd <= 24) can be replaced by one with identical pairwise gcds in which every modulus divides L_all = 16*9*5*7*11*13*17*19*23 (primes >= 25 divide at most one modulus and are deleted; for p < 25 at most one modulus has v_p > e_p = floor(log_p 24) and its exponent is lowered to e_p). Prime support only shrinks. Same argument for general k with 24 -> k-1.
